selection_mode: freeform geometric semantic regions drawn before numerical evaluation

selected_regions.description: A full-cross-section band surrounding the clamped root.
A hand-drawn circular envelope around the through-hole, extruded through the beam width.

semantic_description: The LLM draws one root band and one circular envelope around the through-hole; their union is the semantic candidate support given to Dörfler.
rationale: The root carries the dominant bending and torsional reactions, while the through-hole perturbs stiffness and creates a local stress-transfer disturbance. These two regions are treated as one joint candidate support without mechanically partitioning the rest of the beam.
